newsitem.title: USA: Nutrition for Life signs agreements.
newsitem.headline: Nutrition for Life signs agreements.

text.p: Nutrition for Life International Inc said it signed agreements to resolve legal issues with the states of Florida and Kansas, although implementing the agreements may affect future operating results.
The company did not say when the agreements would affect results or by how much.

Nutrition for Life said in a statement the agreements involve it and Kevin Trudeau, one of its independent distributors, and provide for ''more extensive monitoring of consumer purchases,'' among other things.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment further.
The company later said that as a result of the agreements, it will have to implement a procedure to verify retail sales by distributors in Florida.
According to Melissa Cromwell, a company spokeswoman, ''We have no idea what the cost of implementing the procedure will be, although we don't expect it to be material.''
The company has not begun to implement the procedure yet, she added.
She also said cost of doing so would be ''ongoing'', rather than confined to a specific quarter.
